scope: R1-R3 finite-grid certificate construction and independent TypeScript checking only

requirements.R1: Strict sealed sorted disjoint residue axes, exactly N-1 dimensions, bounded Cartesian scope; trusted expected scope/root digest compared before tree acceptance.
requirements.R2: Flat bounded tree, strict schemas and IDs, unique/reachable/acyclic tree usage, root-box equality and ordered disjoint exhaustive axis partitions; exact BigInt leaf arithmetic and independently recomputed coverage counts.
requirements.R3: GRID exact boundary equality, on-grid rational SHIFT and joint CRT reconstruction; singleton NO_GRID exhausts all M grid points. Resource-limited UNRESOLVED leaves retain their whole domain but never return PASS.

failure_history: Initial TypeScript check found the existing pre-ES2020 target disallows 0n and a test union Omit erased variant fields; repaired without mathematical/domain changes. Final check exit zero.
Contractor review aligned CRT minimum factor count and maximum children with Python consumer, and requested post-hash deadline/final exact byte validation; implemented before final tests.

limits.timing: Cooperative checkpoints include final observed hashing and serialization, not hard synchronous CPU preemption or interpreter attestation. Diagnostic sealing after an expired deadline retains only UNRESOLVED.

scientific_boundary: A PASS certifies exhaustive classifications for the sealed finite Cartesian domain on one fixed M grid, not the unrestricted Lonely Runner Conjecture.
NO_GRID certifies only the absence of a witness among j/M, never a continuous-time counterexample.
SHIFT/CRT leaves are exact finite derived-time witness constructions; no unverified induction lemma or lower-case LRC premise is admitted.
Default generator emits GRID, NO_GRID and SPLIT leaves; SHIFT/CRT are supported and tested, not claimed used by the real default case.
14/15 singleton controls are not complete Allikvere coverage, novelty certification or mathematical expert approval.
